specs.value: Built-in Bluetooth controller, My Chihiros app
Rim clamp bracket with 360° swivel neck
Light panel and swivel arm, rim-mount glass clamp, built-in Bluetooth controller, dual-voltage power adapter and cable
235 x 49 x 13 mm; stand height 20 cm
Aluminium body to help shed heat
1 month from delivery; drops and water damage not covered

fits.fact: Made for nano and mini desktop tanks about 20–45 cm wide.
For bowls, terrariums or wabi-kusa with no glass rim to clamp to, you need the separately sold C II Light Base.
Greendeal says it works best on tanks up to 45 cm and can stretch to 60 cm at most.
Shaquarium gives a recommended range of 30–50 cm, wider than other shops list.
Sellers say the RGB spectrum supports both green and red plants and makes shrimp and snails look more vivid.
Small size suits tight spots such as a desk.

usage.fact: Install the My Chihiros app (App Store or Google Play) and sign up with an email. The account only keeps your lights separate from other users' lights.
Put the alloy stand together, clamp it on the tank, then set the light's height and angle.
Turn on power, switch on Bluetooth and location on your phone, then pick the light from the list of nearby devices in the app.
In the app you can set RGB colour mix, brightness and on/off timers across several time slots, or use the default program.
No separate controller is needed because Bluetooth is built into the light.
The shade (light-blocking hood) is sold separately.

issues.fact: One buyer said the heavy clamp-on light chipped a piece of glass off his nano tank within minutes of mounting. Be careful on thin or rimless nano glass.
One owner measured about 17 W at full power, below the rated 20 W, and asked whether the gap was due to the controller or Bluetooth.
Specs vary between Vietnamese shops (1500 vs 1580 lm; 20–40, 20–45 or 30–50 cm tanks; different dimensions). Check with the seller.
Shop warranty is short: usually only 1 month, with drops and water damage excluded.
The RGB version is an upgrade of the earlier white-only C II. Shops use both names, 'C2' and 'CII', for the same light.
The white C II uses 60 white LEDs at 16 W. The RGB version has 40 RGB 3-in-1 LEDs at 20 W.

alternatives.why: Same body and app for about 500,000₫ less (1,335,000₫ at Shrimp Home), but white light only and lower output (16 W).
Much cheaper at about 690,000₫. Also app-controlled and rotates 360°, with IP54 rating, but weaker at 1000–1100 lm.
About 1,150,000₫ for 30–45 cm tanks. Has RGB plus UV, 1080–1680 lm, app control and a 3-month warranty, but hangs above the tank rather than clamping on.

alternatives.model: AQ WRGB N series Nano II
alternatives.why: Clip-on WRGB nano light at 1,580,000₫, a bit cheaper than the C2 RGB. In stock at Shrimp Home.
